scope: Manual source-to-target semantic review of every one of the 183 supplied text entries, plus source-only invariant checks and a read-only design review of PROTOCOL.md and prepare.py. No case solutions were computed.

findings.detail: All 183 entries were read in full against the Chinese source. Fixed ex-ante choices, every permitted subset, at-most counts, empty events, all-event hard constraints, worst-event utility, strict-positive acceptance, refusal, and no-clarification instructions are preserved.

Reviewed group clawback sums and maxima, complete-group exceptions, capped rebates, per-item and order-level insurance caps, deductibles, 50% coverage, sequential insurance, strict franchise thresholds, retained-spend and weight thresholds, shipping maxima within and across groups, refund floors, cash and service-credit caps, bonus eligibility, shared offsets, and zero-floor-before-admin ordering. No substantive change or new solving equation was found.

The Chinese service-cancellation text switches to people-based wording for the count limit or empty event. The English retains person-count limit and when no one cancels rather than silently repairing this source wording.

The source description of the group discount being restored with a whole-group refund is translated literally. Its explicit cancellation cases and continued inclusion of individual loss remain intact; no added financial explanation resolves the wording.
Restocking charge is used as the English label corresponding to restock, without adding any product-condition limitation. Performance protection remains broad and is not converted into insurance.

The current PROTOCOL.md and prepare.py characterize the contrast as task and schema prose language under byte-identical original Chinese/mixed-language method prompts. It is not an all-English-system comparison. Both languages use new calls, paired input structure and candidate values, shared output schemas, and balanced randomized first-language order. The protocol states single-draw, tokenization, method-visibility, concurrent-load, and task-clustering limitations.

The reviewer queried the universal api_max_output_tokens metadata because Astra is declared to use its native default. The parent reported checking provider_worker.py: codex() ignores api_max_output_tokens and deepseek_max_output_tokens, while deepseek() consumes the DeepSeek cap. This runtime point is parent-verified rather than independently re-read in this source-only review.
No translation edit was requested by this independent review. The translator confirmed the reviewed file hash as final before approval.

limitations: This is a natural-language semantic review, not a formal proof of translation equivalence or causal identification. Automated checks cover only the stated invariants. Private data, gold specifications, reference answers, evaluations, and model outputs were not opened, and no provider API was called. The design review read preparation code and protocol only; it does not independently certify runtime provider behavior, scoring, or reference correctness.
